This role will provide you with valuable experience collaborating with developers, managers and other QA members. What You'll Get to Do Test Automation Development • Write and maintain automated test scripts (UI, API, or integration tests). • Extend existing test suites using the team's automation framework. • Convert manual test cases into automated ones where appropriate. • Debug failing tests and identify root causes. • Prepare or update test data needed for automated tests. Documentation & Test Case Maintenance • Update or create clear test cases and test documentation. • Document automated test coverage, results, and gaps. • Write "how to" notes or small knowledge-based entries for future students or team members. Participation in Team Processes • Join daily standups and regular team meetings. • Collaborate with developers, managers, and other QA members Why You'll Love Working Here • Mentorship from experienced designers and communications pros. • Meaningful projects that serve Albertans and strengthen your portfolio. • Supportive, inclusive team culture with real opportunities to grow. • Exposure to industry-standard, workflows, and systems Why choose Alberta Pensions Services (APS) Alberta Pensions Services (APS) is made up of hard-working, respectful and talented people who understand and invite diversity to the workplace. We take pride in holding ourselves accountable and continuing to meet or exceed service levels for plan members, pensioners and employers. We ensure they receive quality services because they-along with our people-are the reason we endure and succeed. And it sure feels good helping hard-working Albertans receive their well-deserved pensions. Job Requirements The Skills You'll Use (and grow!) • Basic programming experience preferably in languages (C#, .net) • Basic debugging skills able to read logs and trace errors • Detail oriented and thorough. • Strong problem-solving mindset. • Able to ask questions and communicate clearly. • Curious and eager to learn tools, frameworks, and processes. • Comfortable working independently after receiving direction. • Collaboration, problem-solving, and adapting designs based on feedback.
